newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Cricket-Ijaz steers Pakistan to last-gasp win.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Cricket-Ijaz steers Pakistan to last-gasp win.

text.p: Pakistan batsman Ijaz Ahmed scored a dashing 123 to pave the way for a three-wicket victory over Australia A with one ball to spare in a limited overs tour match on Saturday.
Ijaz hammered two sixes and nine fours from 129 balls in an entertaining innings against Australia's second-string one-day side at the Sydney Cricket Ground.
Chasing a daunting target of 293 for victory, the tourists scored at a rate of almost six runs an over to set up a thrilling win with three wickets in hand.
Ijaz added 147 runs for the fourth wicket in partnership with Inzamam-ul-Haq, who contributed an equally hard-hitting 59.
Stuart Law, Michael DiVenuto and Darren Lehmann all scored half-centuries for Australia A, who reached 292 for seven in their 50 overs.
But it was a disappointing match for Ricky Ponting, who failed to impress selectors after being dropped from Australia's test side by losing his wicket cheaply.

Pakistan captain Wasim Akram said the result was a boost for his players, adding that there were "plenty of tired bodies and tired minds" in the camp after several months of almost continuous cricket.
